battle.name: 冬季戰爭
battle.theater: 卡累利阿地峽與曼納海姆防線
battle.brief: 一九三九年十一月三十日蘇聯進攻芬蘭，四〇年三月十三日停火，歷時一百零五天。芬軍在卡累利阿地峽北面的曼納海姆防線死守數月，並以「毛蒂」式公路包抄重創蘇軍縱隊。卡面的英國鐵甲艦不曾在波羅的海露面，但它所確立的「裝甲勝過火砲」觀念，正是本役碉堡與岸防砲位設計的原型。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰方只有兩個主體：芬蘭共和國與蘇聯。芬蘭一邊由國防委員會與參謀總部統率，卡爾·古斯塔夫·埃米爾·曼納海姆元帥出任最高統帥；軍隊骨幹是二萬七千餘名職業軍人，戰時依《徵兵法》大量擴充，另有用來守備城鎮、護送補給的白衛民兵與冬季巡邏隊，以及約三千五百名來自瑞典的志願兵和法國軍事代表團的技術顧問。蘇聯一邊由克里姆林宮直接指揮，地面部隊隸屬列寧格勒軍區第十四軍，軍長基里爾·梅列茨科夫；北方另投入第十五軍與集群編成的部隊，波羅的海艦隊負責封鎖芬蘭灣、掩護登陸與沿岸轟擊，邊境與要塞由內務人民委員部的守備部隊先期布防。戰役分成兩個戰區：卡累利阿地峽是主戰場，芬軍在此擺出曼納海姆防線，蘇方宣稱投入二十一個師、十七萬餘人，芬軍則以十二個師迎戰；北部拉多加湖、薩拉與佩察莫方向的地形更荒蕪，雙方投入都較少。國際方面，國際聯盟在蘇聯開戰後即將其定為侵略行為，英法未出兵，卻以波佛斯高射砲、飛機與信貸形式援助芬蘭，令蘇聯更急於速戰速決，也令西方輿論正式注意到波羅的海的失衡。
countriesEn: There were only two main belligerents: the Republic of Finland and the Soviet Union. On the Finnish side command rested with the Defence Council and the General Staff, with Field Marshal Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim appointed supreme commander; the army's backbone was some twenty-seven thousand career soldiers, massively expanded during the war under the conscription law, supplemented by the White Guard militia used for town defence and supply escort, winter patrol units, roughly three thousand five hundred Swedish volunteers, and the technical advisers of the French military mission. On the Soviet side the Kremlin directed everything: ground forces belonged to the Fourteenth Army of the Leningrad Military District under commander Kirill Meretskov, with the Fifteenth Army and a group formation committed in the north, the Baltic Fleet charged with blockading the Gulf of Finland, covering amphibious operations and providing coastal gunfire, while NKVD border and garrison troops took up positions along the Karelian Isthmus and the Finnish frontier well before the shooting began. The war split into two theatres: the Karelian Isthmus was the main one, where the Finns deployed the Mannerheim Line against a claimed Soviet deployment of twenty-one divisions and some one hundred and seventy thousand men, opposed by twelve Finnish divisions; in the north, around Lake Ladoga, Salla and Petsamo, the terrain was far wilder and both sides committed fewer troops. Internationally, the League of Nations branded the Soviet action aggression as soon as the war began; Britain and France stayed out of the fight but supplied the Finns with Bofors anti-aircraft guns, aircraft and credit, which goaded the Kremlin into seeking a quick decision and forced the western press to confront the imbalance in the Baltic.
people: 曼納海姆是這場戰爭真正的總指揮。他以第一次世界大戰在波羅的海與黑海的經驗，主張放棄正面密集突擊，把芬軍分散成小單位，以森林、湖沼、積雪與嚴寒當作防禦的骨架，用步槍、機槍與反戰車武器去對付裝甲，而不是用血肉去換突破。總統里斯托·呂提在政治上替軍方擋住蘇聯割地與驅逐德軍的要求，外交部長魯道夫·瓦爾登則在巴黎、倫敦與日內瓦之間奔走，替芬蘭爭到援助與一條不被立刻接受的和談通道。戰場上的名字一個個立起來：西拉斯窩所率第九師在蘇奧穆薩米與拉阿特公路用森林阻擊拆掉蘇軍縱隊，帕加里的第三師在奧盧、馬爾基耶爾維與塔利－伊漢塔拉死守後反擊，塔爾維拉在拉特路一帶帶游擊隊切斷公路，一月中起接掌參謀總部的海因里希斯重整冬季作戰條例，佩特納寧主持的國防委員會在關鍵時刻授權前線自行決斷。蘇聯那邊，斯大林與莫洛托夫拍板開戰並下令全程封鎖消息；梅列茨科夫屢攻不下被撤，戰局末期由季莫申科接手整個西北戰線，伏羅希洛夫以人民委員與國防委員會委員身份坐鎮，朱可夫遠在遠東軍區無從參與，邊疆與要塞的失守則被內務人民委員部掩蓋。戰爭中蘇軍一度下令不接受俘虜，直至四〇年一月才改令。
peopleEn: Mannerheim was the true commander of this war. Drawing on his First World War experience in the Baltic and the Black Sea, he argued for abandoning mass frontal assaults, dispersing the Finnish army into small units, and using forest, lake, deep snow and severe cold as the skeleton of the defence, meeting armour with rifles, machine guns and anti-tank weapons rather than trading blood for penetrations. President Risto Ryti politically shielded the army against Soviet demands for territory and the expulsion of German volunteers, while foreign minister Rudolf Walden worked between Paris, London and Geneva to win the Finns aid and a negotiated channel that would not be accepted at once. Names were made on the battlefield: Hjalmar Siilasvuo's Ninth Division broke up Soviet columns in the forests of Suomussalmi and on the Raate road; Aaro Pajari's Third Division held at Oulu, Märkäjärvi and Tali-Ihantala before counterattacking; Paavo Talvela ran guerrilla bands that cut the roads around Lahti; Erik Heinrichs took over the General Staff in mid-January and recast winter warfare doctrine; and Vilho Petter Neninen's Defence Council authorised the front to decide for itself at critical moments. On the Soviet side Stalin and Molotov decided on war and ordered total secrecy; Meretskov was removed after repeated failure and Timoshenko took over the whole Northwestern Front at the end, with Voroshilov presiding as People's Commissar and Defence Council member, Zhukov tied down in the Far East, and the NKGD covering up the failures at the border forts and the islets. At one point the Red Army was ordered to take no prisoners, a standing order only rescinded in January 1940.
kits: 卡面這件一八六二年的英國鐵甲艦並未出現在波羅的海，它屬於另一條技術譜系的最後一環：木殼外包鐵板，砲塔的旋轉軸心從此由裝甲決定而非由船殼決定，裝甲第一次在火力對抗中站到了砲口之前。卡累利阿地峽的碉堡群正是這套邏輯的陸地版：鋼筋混凝土的正面壁厚達數十公分，砲位與機槍位都讓開裝甲核心、繞著它佈置，反戰車砲與機槍的射界同樣以防護結構為基準；蘇奧明蘭納的岸防重砲與要塞群則把「裝甲平台上架大砲」的舊式構思帶到一九三九年，掩體與砲位一同承受直射火力。地面武器方面，芬軍主力是蘇奧米 KP-31 衝鋒槍（每分鐘八百發，一九四〇年量產七千支以上）、薩赫拉－薩洛蘭塔 M/26 輕機槍、馬克西姆 M/31 重機槍、七十六毫米 K/18 野戰砲與一百零五毫米 K/13 榴砲，抗甲板是二十二毫米 Kt-39 與 Ptz-39 步槍，坦克只有少量波蘭製七噸式與繳獲的 T-26，冬季服裝與雪地履帶車是芬軍冬季機動的真正裝備。蘇軍則以 T-26 配四十五毫米砲、BT-7 快速戰車為先鋒，二月總攻時加入 T-34/76 與 KV-1，砲兵多達數千門，另有三七〇毫米與一五二毫米榴彈砲。
kitsEn: The ironclad on the card never appeared in the Baltic; it belongs to the far end of a different technical lineage: an iron skin wrapped over a wooden hull, with the gun turret's axis now determined by the armour rather than by the shell of the ship, so that armour for the first time stood in front of the guns in a contest of fire. The bunker complexes of the Karelian Isthmus were the landward version of that logic: reinforced concrete frontal walls tens of centimetres thick, gun and machine-gun positions laid out around the armoured core rather than on it, and the fields of fire of the anti-tank guns and machine guns likewise based on the protective structure. The coastal heavy guns and fortress works of Suomenlinna carried the old idea of a big gun mounted on an armoured platform into 1939, with the casemate and the emplacement taking direct fire together. On the ground, the Finnish main equipment was the Suomi KP-31 submachine gun (eight hundred rounds a minute, more than seven thousand produced in 1940), the Lahti-Saloranta M/26 light machine gun, the Maxim M/31 heavy machine gun, the 76 mm K/18 field gun and the 105 mm K/13 howitzer; against armour they had the 22 mm Kt-39 and Ptz-39 rifles, while their tanks amounted to a handful of Polish 7TP types and captured T-26s, with winter clothing and snow-running vehicles the real kit of Finnish mobility. The Soviets led with T-26s mounting 45 mm guns and BT-7 fast tanks, added T-34/76 and KV-1 for the February offensive, brought several thousand artillery pieces into action, and used 370 mm and 152 mm howitzers.
tactics: 芬軍的戰術核心是「不戰而屈人之兵」的森林消耗：把防禦縱深拉長成數百公里的稀疏據點網，每個據點自成一個口袋，蘇軍進入森林後即失去射界與統一指揮，公路縱隊被切斷前後，燃料與彈藥在零下三十度以下迅速失效，步兵在雪地裡凍傷、飢餓與耗盡彈藥，最後成建制投降，這套做法在蘇奧穆薩米與拉阿特公路被稱為「毛蒂」戰術。曼納海姆防線本身是縱深梯次配置，混凝土碉堡、鋼製轉射砲塔、反戰車壕、機槍巢與地雷場交錯連接，射擊一律指向可能接近的方向，蘇軍必須逐點攻破，速率極慢。芬軍大量使用冬裝、白色偽裝、雪鞋與摩托雪橇，步兵以散兵依托樹幹射擊，衝鋒槍與輕機槍在近距離橫掃；二月主動反擊時，芬軍以滑雪部隊切斷蘇軍側翼公路，再用反戰車步槍逐段殲滅被拖慢的裝甲集群。蘇軍的戰術則相反：企圖以密集火砲一舉覆蓋防線，再以步兵集團在窄正面強攻，裝甲部隊集中使用往往反而因地形與雪陷而遲滯，最終仍靠火砲與工兵強行打通缺口。
tacticsEn: The core of Finnish tactics was a forest attrition fought without battles: the defence was spread into a sparse net of strongpoints hundreds of kilometres deep, each strongpoint a pocket of its own, so that Soviet columns entering the forest lost both field of fire and unified command, while road columns had their head and tail cut off and their fuel and ammunition failed quickly at temperatures below minus thirty, leaving infantry to freeze, starve and run out of cartridges before they were finally taken in large numbers, surrendering in organised groups. This practice at Suomussalmi and on the Raate road became known as the motti tactic. The Mannerheim Line itself was laid out in echeloned depth, with concrete bunkers, armoured turrets, anti-tank ditches, machine-gun nests and minefields interlaced, every gun facing the direction from which an approach might come, so that the Soviets had to break the line point by point at a very slow rate of advance. The Finns used winter clothing, white camouflage, skis and motor sledges, individual riflemen shooting from tree trunks, and submachine guns and light machine guns sweeping the short ranges; in the February counteroffensive ski troops cut the roads on the Soviet flanks and anti-tank rifles killed off the armoured groups one segment at a time. Soviet tactics ran the other way: massed artillery was expected to overwhelm the line, infantry groups attacked on a narrow front, and armour was massed in the hope of speed, though in this terrain and snow the vehicles bogged down and the breach had to be forced by artillery and engineers in the end.
data: 戰役自一九三九年十一月三十日至四〇年三月十三日，共一百零五天。曼納海姆防線全長約三百五十公里，混凝土碉堡一千六百座、木質與土質掩體約一千二百座、裝甲轉射砲塔約五十座，配置火炮約一千門、反戰車砲約三百門、機槍約一千八百挺。芬軍在最高潮時動員約三十萬人，初始常備兵力約二萬七千人；蘇方公稱在卡累利阿地峽投入二十一個師、十七萬餘人、火砲一千五百五十門、戰車三百餘輛、飛機六百五十四架，芬方估計實際可用兵力遠低於此。蘇軍二月初總攻宣稱使用火砲三千五百四十一門、戰車九百八十輛、飛機七百六十架。傷亡方面，芬軍官方記錄陣亡約二萬六千九百人、負傷約四萬三千五百人；蘇軍傷亡總數約十二萬六千八百人，其中陣亡約二萬一千六百餘人、失聯與被俘數萬人，芬軍關戰末期收容蘇軍俘虜約五千五百人。戰前蘇軍公佈的俘虜總數為零，而德國與瑞典方向的商船損失與波羅的海航運中斷亦牽動雙方補給。
dataEn: The campaign ran from 30 November 1939 to 13 March 1940, one hundred and five days in all. The Mannerheim Line extended some three hundred and fifty kilometres and contained about 1,600 concrete bunkers, some 1,200 wooden and earth dugouts, and roughly fifty armoured turrets, with around 1,000 guns, some 300 anti-tank guns and about 1,800 machine guns. Finland mobilised to roughly three hundred thousand men at the height of the fighting, starting from a regular army of about twenty-seven thousand. The Soviets officially claimed twenty-one divisions and more than 170,000 men on the Karelian Isthmus, with 1,551 guns, over three hundred tanks and 654 aircraft, while Finnish estimates put the actually available strength far lower. For the February general offensive the Soviet side claimed 3,541 guns, 980 tanks and 760 aircraft. On casualties, Finnish official figures record about 26,900 dead and 43,500 wounded; Soviet losses are put in total at about 126,800, of which roughly 21,600 dead, with tens of thousands missing or captured, and the Finns held some 5,500 Soviet prisoners by the war's end. The Soviets had announced a prisoner count of zero before the war, and losses among merchant shipping in the Baltic and the disruption of Baltic shipping also weighed on both sides' supply lines.
cause: 起因是多瑙河事件後的東歐秩序重排。一九三九年八月蘇德互不侵犯條約瓜分波蘭，蘇聯隨即在芬蘭邊境集中兵力，向芬蘭提出三項要求：撕毀一九三二年蘇芬互不侵犯條約、從芬蘭境內驅走德國志願兵、割讓卡累利阿地峽以保證列寧格勒安全。芬蘭議會拒絕割地，蘇聯於十一月十四日發出最後通牒，凍結條約並召回使節；十一月二十六日莫伊西奧村外的邊界事件中，蘇軍坦克向芬軍開火，成為開戰的藉口，芬方說法與蘇方說法從此各執一詞。國際聯盟在開戰後的譴責、西方對芬蘭的援助承諾、以及蘇聯必須在冬季封凍前解決北極圈邊境與波羅的海海峽的戰略考慮，共同推動了三十日的全面進攻。
causeEn: The cause lay in the reordering of eastern Europe after the events in the Danube. In August 1939 the Soviet-German non-aggression pact carved up Poland, and the Kremlin immediately massed troops on the Finnish frontier and put three demands to Finland: annul the 1932 Soviet-Finnish non-aggression treaty, expel the German volunteers from Finnish territory, and cede the Karelian Isthmus to guarantee Leningrad's security. The Finnish parliament refused the cession, and on 14 November the Soviet Union delivered an ultimatum, froze the treaty and withdrew its envoys. On 26 November the border incident at the village of Mainila, in which a Soviet tank fired on Finnish troops, became the pretext for war, and the Finnish and Soviet accounts of that clash have never agreed. The League of Nations' condemnation after the war began, Western promises of aid to Finland, and the Soviet need to settle the Arctic frontier and the Gulf of Finland before the winter freeze all pushed the two sides towards the general attack of the 30th.
impact: 這場戰爭改寫了北歐的安全版圖。芬蘭割讓卡累利阿地峽、拉多加卡累利亞、佩察莫北部與薩拉等約一萬一千平方公里的土地，租借漢科半島三十載，約四十萬芬蘭人被迫離鄉，維堡等城市的芬蘭人口從此在蘇聯境內成為少數族群，這條族群裂痕一直延續到今日。軍事上，蘇軍雖勝卻付出遠高於預期的代價，逼出一九四〇年後紅軍的改革：火砲與步兵分離的密集衝鋒被否定，裝甲與步兵協同、縱深突破的「大縱深戰役」理論在卡累利阿的雪地裡被迫接受檢驗，此後整個紅軍的戰術教材都以此役為反面教材。芬蘭方面則因國民不屈的表現獲得國際聲望，曼納海姆成為民族英雄，戰後芬軍的冬季作戰與森林游擊經驗被各國陸軍學院研究，一九四〇年芬蘭加入反蘇同盟、翌年再戰，最終在一九四四年退出戰爭。蘇聯一九五四年公開承認莫伊西奧事件責任，也讓此役的真相在六十年後才補上。
impactEn: The war redrew the security map of northern Europe. Finland ceded roughly eleven thousand square kilometres including the Karelian Isthmus, Ladoga Karelia, northern Petsamo and Salla, and leased the Hanko peninsula for thirty years; about four hundred thousand Finns were uprooted, and the Finnish population of cities such as Vyborg became a minority inside the Soviet Union, a demographic rupture that is still visible today. Militarily the Soviet Union won but at a cost far above expectation, and the reckoning forced the reform of the Red Army after 1940: the massed infantry rush unsupported by artillery was discredited, combined-arms cooperation between armour and infantry and the deep operation were tested against the snow of Karelia, and for years afterwards the red army's training manuals used this campaign as a negative example. On the Finnish side the endurance of the people brought the country international standing, Mannerheim became a national hero, and the winter warfare and forest guerrilla experience of the Finnish army was studied in staff colleges abroad; Finland joined the anti-Soviet coalition in 1940, fought again in 1941, and eventually withdrew from the war in 1944. The Soviet Union only acknowledged the Mainila incident in 1954, so the full truth of this campaign was not completed until sixty years afterwards.
result: 停火於四〇年三月十三日生效，莫斯科和約在三月十二日簽訂：芬蘭放棄卡累利阿地峽、維堡、拉多加卡累利亞、佩察莫北部與薩拉，租借漢科，維持獨立與主權，蘇聯承擔不攻擊芬蘭的義務。就軍事結果而言，蘇聯佔領了所要的土地但未能使芬軍投降，芬蘭則在曼納海姆防線上守住了國家與軍隊的完整，成為一場以守代攻、由慘勝換取存續的戰爭。此役同時埋下下一輪衝突的種子：芬蘭在和約中得知蘇聯的實力與意圖，一九四〇年六月蘇聯遷移波羅的海艦隊與首都，一九四一年芬蘭再與德國結盟開戰，最終以一九四四年九月與蘇聯停戰、一九四五年四月對德和戰收場。
resultEn: The ceasefire took effect on 13 March 1940, and the Moscow Peace Treaty was signed on the 12th: Finland surrendered the Karelian Isthmus, Vyborg, Ladoga Karelia, northern Petsamo and Salla, leased Hanko, and kept its independence and sovereignty, while the Soviet Union undertook not to attack Finland. In military terms the Soviets took the territory they wanted but failed to break the Finnish army, and Finland held the Mannerheim Line with its state and army intact, a war fought by standing and taking heavy losses rather than by breaking the enemy. The campaign also planted the seed of the next round: told by the peace terms what Soviet strength and intent were like, and after the Soviet move of the Baltic Fleet and the capital in June 1940, Finland allied with Germany and went to war again in 1941, ending with the armistice with the Soviet Union in September 1944 and the surrender to the Western Allies in April 1945.
